title: How Far Can a PSRAM-less ESP32 Go? A TinyML Deployment Study for WiFi CSI HAR
description: Code, executed notebook (with outputs), on-device measurement firmware, results, and trained models (sklearn .joblib, int8 .tflite, emlearn C) for a deployment-characterization study of WiFi CSI human activity recognition on the classic PSRAM-less ESP32. Covers classical learners, tiny neural networks, and five deep architectures on UT-HAR and CSI-HAR, with measured on-device latency and memory.
